card.name: Linking words in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as AND, TO, ARE or a comma inside all-capital boxed warning text, most often the AND in "SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATENING".

modes.label: AND after SERIOUS
modes.description: The word AND in the boxed-warning headline "WARNING: SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATENING RISKS".

modes.label: Other all-caps linkers
modes.description: Other small words or punctuation inside capitalized warning phrases, including a split-up word.
modes.example: FREQUENT EVALUATION AND LABORATORY DETERMINATIONS<< ARE>> NECESSARY FOR PROPER MONITOR

card.plain: It fires on small joining words inside the all-capital boxed warning headings on drug labels.
